name: RINoBench
description: RINoBench is the first comprehensive benchmark for large-scale evaluation of research idea novelty judgments. It contains 1,381 research ideas judged by human experts and includes nine automated evaluation metrics assessing rubric-based novelty scores and textual justifications, enabling standardized evaluation of automated novelty judgment approaches.
reputation: A new benchmark for novelty judgment that is useful for studying automated research-idea evaluation, but it is still early-stage and not yet broadly established.
notes: Focuses on automated judgment of research idea novelty with human expert judgments as gold standard; reveals divergence between LLM judgments and human judgments.
